title: Substrate Card v3 -- v2 + the key EXPRESSION the L0 manifest receiver requires
description: SUPERSEDES v2 AT THE WAVE BOUNDARY, NOT MID-WAVE (the same rule v2 stated for v1). v2 stays the freeze for waves 1-3 of NFRA_SUBSTRATECARDING; every delivered v2 card stays valid under v2. v3 exists because the L0 manifest's `key` RECEIVER (L0_GRAPH_SUBSTRATE_MANIFEST.schema.json #/$defs/part/properties/key) REQUIRES a `key_expression` and v2's trust.key row had no slot for it -- the card could name a key's SPACE, stability and cross-space standing but not the EXPRESSION that yields a member's key, so no card population could ever satisfy the manifest's EMISSION gate (D11_SUBSTRATE_ANALYSIS_PRD.md sec 10.2: 0 of 42 parts carrying all four receivers; a SOURCE gap that 'card harder' cannot close). ONE field added, in the receiver's own vocabulary (read from the manifest schema by build_substrate_card_v3.py, never retyped): trust.key.key_expression. Absence is EXPRESSIBLE, never silent: null is legal ONLY with basis_by_field.key_expression = 'absent' (and therefore the row's floor basis is not 'measured'). Everything else is v2 verbatim. || SUPERSEDES v1 AT THE WAVE BOUNDARY, NOT MID-WAVE. v1 is the FREEZE for wave 1 of NFRA_SUBSTRATECARDING and stays operative there; four TOs and a staged verifier harness reference it, and Rule 27 holds the spec frozen mid-round. v2 exists because 2.0.0_SA_COO~X exercised v1 during the decomp (72935) and found THREE requirements that lived in prose a validator cannot branch on -- the exact CLAUDE.md section-4 defect this project exists to measure, committed inside the project's own contract. In v1 those three are carried as TO acceptance criteria (AC3/AC4/AC5); here they are carried by the schema, so wave 2 does not depend on anyone remembering. The machine-checkable deliverable of a Rule 28 qualification. Seven questions over three DECLARED grains (PROCESS / ARTIFACT / TRUST). Every row carries its own BASIS, EVIDENCE and OWNER, because Rule 24(iv): the values do not move together and neither do their remedies. Shape follows a document-envelope pattern -- a governed document declares how it came to exist, what it claims temporally, where it lives, and what it is a projection of -- extended with the TRUST grain, which describes whether the thing can be STOOD ON rather than merely what it is.

composes.description: What it reuses. Empty array is a claim, not a gap. || x-names-parts: TRUE. ⛔ THIS FIELD NAMES OTHER PARTS OF THE ESTATE, and any derivation over cards MUST enumerate EVERY field carrying this marker rather than a remembered subset. Added on 2.0.0_SA_COO~X's 73934: the wave-2 subject derivation read composes + projection_of and NEVER READ co_resident_stores -- 13 heads, 12 named ONLY there -- and what went missing included '.comp-graph/graph.json', THE C3 CHAIN'S OWN STAGE-1 SUBSTRATE, from a wave whose purpose is qualifying what C3.i stands on. THE ROOT IS SCHEMA DESIGN, NOT THE DERIVATION: I authored FOUR fields that name parts and marked NONE of them as a class, so the only way to know the set was to remember it -- and SC-m-4's oracle ('reconstructible from composes + projection_of ALONE') froze a remembered subset into an accepted oracle, which I reviewed and did not catch either. A consumer reading a SUBSET of a class it cannot enumerate produces a clean, complete-looking, INCOMPLETE answer -- the coverage axis failing at design time rather than at read time.

invents.description: What it ORIGINATES. ⛔ x-names-parts DELIBERATELY NOT SET, and the removal is MEASURED not reasoned: I marked this field as part-naming when adding the class marker, then enumerated wave-1's 8 delivered cards and found 21 heads via `invents`, ALL 21 UNIQUE to it and ZERO of them a store. Every one is a DEFINITION, THRESHOLD or CLASSIFICATION -- 'the >=2-member domain-promotion threshold', 'SIM_TWIN = 0.60', "the 'orphan' motif classification", 'the THIN/UNKNOWN blind-row band', 'the lifecycle_class enum (7 values)'. A parts-derivation reading this field would enumerate 21 CONCEPTS as if they were STORES and try to card them, which is the CARRIER-3 error ('a population is not a store') at 21x scale. ⛔ AND THE REAL FINDING: THIS IS declared_opinions CONTENT. Wave-1 lanes recorded the semantic-defect axis here because it was the only slot that fit, BEFORE declared_opinions existed. So 21 opinions are already harvested from wave 1 at zero cost and belong in methodology.declared_opinions going forward. ORIGINAL INTENT RETAINED: a resource that INVENTS what it should COMPOSE is a duplicate waiting to diverge -- if a lane ever names an actual PART here, that is a duplicate-implementation signal and a finding in its own right, not a subject for a parts sweep.

basis.description: How this row's answer was arrived at. THIS SCALAR IS THE FLOOR -- the WEAKEST claim across the row's sub-claims, never the mode and never the best. Ordering strongest to weakest: measured > held > inferred > absent ('held' outranks 'inferred' because a named authority DID measure it, just not here). If ANY part of the row is held or inferred, THE ROW IS NOT 'measured'. A scalar reporting the BEST sub-claim over-promises a consumer BY THE SCHEMA'S OWN HAND, which is worse than the gap it replaces.

VOCABULARY REUSED, NOT RE-COINED: identical values and identical meaning to `generation.materializer_standing` in L0_GRAPH_SUBSTRATE_MANIFEST.schema.json, where the four-postulate x-rule24 record lives. Naming it `generator_currency` here and `materializer_standing` there would have been one concept in two id spaces -- this estate's most repeated defect, inside my own two contracts. 'not_applicable' covers a subject that no materializer produces.

declared_opinions.description: THE SEMANTIC-DEFECT AXIS. Every filter, threshold, exclusion, cutoff and definitional choice this subject's producer makes -- ENUMERATED. ⛔ ADDED MID-WAVE-2 AND OPTIONAL BY DESIGN: 2.0.0_SA_COO~X dispatched wave 2 with a KNOWN CONTRACT GAP on every TO face -- the field existed in L0_GRAPH_SUBSTRATE_MANIFEST.schema.json but NOT here, though it is the ONE field the canonical-materializer consumer reads, so lanes were told to put it in methodology.how as PROSE and disclose the reason in evidence. That is knowingly the F-2 shape: a claim living where a validator cannot branch on it. The gap is mine. NULL IS LEGAL AND LOUD -- it means the producer's opinions are BURIED IN CODE and this subject is UNREVIEWABLE on the semantic axis, which is itself the finding. OMITTING the field entirely is ALSO CONFORMING, because wave-2 lanes were dispatched against the contract without it and no in-flight card may be invalidated by an additive change. Why a contract and not a scanner: a producer can have run this morning and still encode a deprecated opinion, and every freshness instrument -- mtime, snapshot id, last-write, a wave as_of -- is STRUCTURALLY BLIND to it. No instrument in this estate discriminates a bad definition. The only thing that makes one reviewable is REQUIRING IT BE DECLARED RATHER THAN BURIED, because the defect is not 'wrong opinion', it is 'opinion that cannot be found'.

A card whose key row is 'measured' with a null expression is the contradiction v3 exists to make unrepresentable.

x-enum-definitions.SOUND: Every row measured; no defect that blocks load-bearing use.
x-enum-definitions.QUALIFIED: Every row measured; defects present, NAMED, and each carrying an owner. Usable within the stated limits.
x-enum-definitions.UNSOUND: A measured defect that blocks load-bearing use until remedied.
x-enum-definitions.INCOMPLETE: One or more rows unmeasured. THIS IS A VERDICT ABOUT THE CARD, NOT ABOUT THE RESOURCE -- the two are routinely collapsed, and collapsing them turns 'we did not finish looking' into 'it is fine'.

x-rule24.state_coherence: INCOMPLETE resolves to one of the other three by measurement; UNSOUND -> QUALIFIED/SOUND requires a REMEDY, not a re-read -- different clocks, which is why the owner column is mandatory

forward_disposition.description:
WHAT BECOMES OF THIS SUBJECT IN THE CANONICAL REBUILD. Andrew-direct 2026-08-26, VERBATIM: 'do a wave 2 substrate carding to get all the definitions of these things as they stand currently, but some of them i think we can safely say will be deprecated, and we will want to go through and identify and mark those cards with some kind of deprecation tag AFTER carding.' ⛔ THE WORD 'AFTER' IS THE DESIGN. A card DESCRIBES what is; a disposition DECIDES what should be. Mixing them would be Rule 24(iii) intent incoherence -- and worse, a lane that carded and dispositioned in one pass would be adjudicating its own subject. Born UNDECIDED and set in a SECOND pass by a seat with the authority to retire something.

NAMED forward_disposition, NOT 'disposition': that token already carries a DIFFERENT meaning in this project (0.4.0_DT_ClientPlatform~X's manifest reconcile, where a 'disposition' is how a residue item was classified to sum to 42). One word, two meanings, is the estate's most repeated defect and it would have been minted here on the day this project measured it five times.

x-enum-definitions.keep: Survives the canonical rebuild substantially as-is.
x-enum-definitions.replace: A canonical agnostic materializer supersedes it; the FUNCTION continues, this IMPLEMENTATION does not.
x-enum-definitions.deprecate: Retired, and nothing replaces it -- the need itself is gone or was never real.
x-enum-definitions.undecided: THE BORN STATE. Not yet adjudicated. Never defaulted to 'keep' because a thing currently runs.

x-rule24.domain: what becomes of one carded subject in the canonical rebuild
x-rule24.intent: ONE intent -- decide the subject's forward fate. Deliberately NOT what the card's other rows do, which is DESCRIBE its present state.
x-rule24.mece: keep / replace / deprecate partition the decided cases (survives · function survives but implementation does not · nothing survives); 'undecided' covers the not-yet-adjudicated member, which is the state EVERY card is born in per the 'after carding' instruction.
x-rule24.state_coherence: THE VALUES DO NOT MOVE TOGETHER. undecided -> any is an ADJUDICATION. keep -> deprecate is a RETIREMENT DECISION with an owner and a blast radius, never a re-reading. replace -> keep means the canonical materializer FAILED to cover the case, which is a finding about the rebuild and not about this subject.
x-rule24.token_census: word-boundary occupancy at 275fe497c7 over org/standards + the D11 PRD + the rule bank: disposition 2 (DIFFERENT meaning, see description), deprecate 0, deprecated 2, replace 1, retire 2, supersede 0. 'forward_disposition' 0 -- no collision.

set_by.description: Serial of the seat that adjudicated. NULL while undecided. ⛔ MUST NOT be the carding lane for its own subject -- describing and deciding are different acts and the carding seat has a stake in the second.

basis.description: How this row's answer was arrived at. A VALUE MUST CARRY ITS CLAIM in a field a consumer can reject on -- never in prose, a name, or the reader's memory of how it was produced.

x-enum-definitions.measured: Read or exercised directly against the thing itself.
x-enum-definitions.inferred: Reasoned from adjacent evidence. NON-ACTIONABLE on its own.
x-enum-definitions.held: Asserted by a named authority without independent measurement here.
x-enum-definitions.absent: No basis exists yet. Honest, and required rather than guessing.

x-rule24.domain: epistemic standing of one card row
x-rule24.intent: let a consumer REFUSE an unmeasured value
x-rule24.mece: measured/inferred/held partition the cases where an answer exists; 'absent' covers the no-answer member
x-rule24.state_coherence: absent -> measured is work; inferred -> measured is re-derivation with a different instrument, never a re-run of the same command

evidence.description: The grounding: 'file:line @ <commit-ish>', a command exercised with its output, or an explicit 'NONE -- basis is inferred/absent'. A line citation without a vintage is not a citation.

owner.description: Serial or role who owns the REMEDY for this row. Rule 24(iv): a stale cache, a missing id grammar and a silent failure mode are three remedies, three owners, three clocks. A card without owners is a wish list. 'UNOWNED' is a legal and loud value.

joinable_ref.description: ⛔ AN IDENTITY AND A DESCRIPTION ARE TWO FIELDS, NOT ONE STRING. v2 addition on 2.0.0_SA_COO~X's finding 73294: with these arrays typed as bare strings, lanes correctly wrote entries like 'kuzu_nessie_db -- EMBEDDED COUNT SURFACES ONLY (...)' -- individually more informative than a bare id, and jointly UNJOINABLE. Measured across 8 wave-1 cards: 51 raw entries, 43 distinct subjects, 6 subjects carrying MULTIPLE SPELLINGS, and a consumer taking them at face value would enumerate 51 parts where 43 exist -- AN OVER-COUNT THAT LOOKS LIKE THOROUGHNESS, the most dangerous shape a census error can take. NO LANE COULD HAVE AVOIDED IT WHILE FOLLOWING THE SCHEMA; the defect was the field type.

id.description: THE JOINABLE IDENTITY, and nothing else. A bare identifier a consumer matches on WITHOUT parsing prose. No ' -- ', no parentheticals, no qualification. ENFORCED, not merely asked: an id containing ' -- ' or ' (' is REJECTED. Those are the exact two prose markers 2.0.0_SA_COO~X's dedup heuristic had to key on across 8 cards, which is the measurement that says they are the shapes that actually occur. Without this the fix separates the SLOTS and lets the prose walk straight back into the identity -- a fix that looks applied and is not.

note.description: The qualification that would otherwise be jammed into the id. Free prose, never joined on, and its presence is why the id can stay clean.

basis_by_field.description: PER-SUB-CLAIM PROVENANCE, keyed by the field it covers. v2 addition on the P1 class measured across TWO contracts and THREE instances by 0.4.0_DT_ClientPlatform~X, 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp~X and 2.0.0_SA_COO~X: one enum over a unit containing mixed-provenance parts forces a single value, and the truth survives only as prose in `evidence`, where no validator can branch on it. MEASURED CONSEQUENCE: 4 of 21 rows in ACCEPTED, VERIFIED cards read basis='measured' while carrying a HELD sub-claim. THE CARDS WERE NOT AT FAULT -- every one disclosed the held part in prose. The contract had nowhere to put the truth.

then.description: SOUND asserts EVERY ROW MEASURED. A row at basis 'absent' contradicts that, and the PRD's own warning is that 'we did not finish looking' ships as 'it is fine'. v2 makes the contradiction unrepresentable.
